sources.title: GPT‑5.6: Frontier intelligence that scales with your ambition
sources.snippet: Efficient by default, maximum performance on demand GPT‑5.6 Sol is our best coding model yet. On the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index, GPT‑5.6 Sol with max reasoning sets a new state of the art at 80, 2.8 points above Fable 5, while using less than half the output tokens, taking less than half the time, and costing about one-third less.

sources.title: GPT-5.6 SOL Jailbreaks and Agentic Cyber Risk - penligent.ai
sources.snippet: OpenAI confirmed that GPT-5.6 faced universal jailbreaks during pre-deployment cyber testing. Learn what the 83% result really means, how agentic capabilities change the risk, and how defenders should test and contain AI systems.

sources.title: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol Brings 54% Efficiency Boost to Agentic Coding
sources.snippet: OpenAI just dropped GPT-5.6 Sol with a massive 54% efficiency gain on agentic coding tasks. But what does this mean for developers, enterprises, and the future of AI? The details might surprise you as the company navigates safety and broad access.
